description: This PHP class defines the BuzzShare entity for the OrangeHRM system, representing a social media share or post with properties like post reference, employee reference, likes, comments, type, text, and timestamps. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for property access and mutations.

classes.name: BuzzShare
classes.description: Defines the entity for social media sharing within the OrangeHRM system, including properties for post details, employee, likes, comments, and timestamps, with ORM mapping annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the BuzzShare instance.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the BuzzShare instance.

methods.name: setPost
methods.description: Associates a BuzzPost entity with this share.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this share.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity associated with this share.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the share (post/share).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the share.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Gets the text content of the share.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the share.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Retrieves the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Retrieves the last update timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the last update timestamp in UTC.
